//: Merge into <project>/.claude/settings.json. Comments are not valid JSON — strip the // keys before use.
//plansDirectory: Where built-in plan mode writes its plan files. Relative to the project root; must stay inside it. Without this, plans land in ~/.claude/plans/ and are not version-controlled. Set it: in plan mode the harness owns the plan path outright, so this is what keeps that file inside the repository too. Note /make-plan refuses to run while plan mode is active — the two are alternatives, not layers.
//env: Do NOT set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL. It takes precedence over every agent's model: frontmatter, which would silently collapse the whole tiering onto one model.
//modelSettings: Optional. The safety net for the orchestrator tier if the skill pin drops: a skill's model:/effort: frontmatter applies for the current turn only, so /execute-plan falls back to the SESSION effort the moment a delegation returns as a background completion notification. This pins that fallback to medium for Sonnet sessions. It is per-model, so an Opus planning session is untouched. It does not reach agent frontmatter: implementer still overrides to effort: high in its own file regardless.
//permissions: Optional. Pre-allowing the read-only commands the orchestrator runs constantly cuts prompt fatigue during a long plan run.
